en.title: Show GN: Can I Remove This? – An Agent Skill for JS Dependency Removal
en.hook: An AI Agent skill designed to automatically analyze and evaluate whether JavaScript package dependencies can be safely removed.
key_takeaways: Automatically scans and analyzes unused or replaceable JS package dependencies within a project
Implemented as an LLM Agent Skill, easily extendable into existing code-analysis AI workflows
Helps reduce web bundle size and automates legacy dependency refactoring

zh.title: Show GN: Can I Remove This? – 评估 JS 依赖项移除的 Agent Skill
